title: Global Distribution Expeditionary Contract
description: In accordance with RFO FAR 6.103-1, the Defense Logistics Agency (DLA) Distribution intends to issue modification P00024 against Contract SP330021D5002 on a sole source basis to Olgoonik Federal, LLC. This contract known as the Global Distribution Expeditionary Contract (GDEC) provides critical labor and distribution support for workload surges, unforeseen or unplanned requirements, contingency operations, humanitarian missions, labor augmentation, and special projects. The modification will increase the contract ceiling by $90,000,000.00, raising the total ceiling to $315,500,000.00. This increase is necessary because the current ceiling will be fully obligated prior to the end of the six month extension period, based on historical usage rates and projected surge and contingency requirements. The additional ceiling represents the minimum amount needed to maintain uninterrupted mission support.This action is being taken pursuant to RFO FAR 6.103-1(c)(2)(ii), as only the incumbent contractor, Olgoonik Federal, LLC, can provide the required services without unacceptable delays. Standing up a new contractor would require onboarding, security vetting, facility access approvals, training, and integration with DLA Distribution systems activities that cannot be completed within the required time frame. The incumbent currently maintains the necessary staffing, facilities, equipment, and materials to continue immediate performance.This temporary extension is required because follow on procurements the DLA Distribution Expeditionary Capabilities Contract (DECAP) and the DLA Distribution Labor Augmentation Contract will not be awarded in time to meet immediate and ongoing operational requirements.Without this ceiling increase and short term extension, DLA Distribution would not have a viable contract vehicle to support mission essential surge, contingency, humanitarian, or audit readiness requirements during the gap between the expiration of the current ordering period and the commencement of follow on contracts. The Justification and Approval document supporting this non competitive action will be posted to SAM.gov once fully executed.This notice is for informational purposes only. It is not a solicitation for proposals or an invitation for bids. The Government does not anticipate receiving responses to this announcement of a proposed non competitive action.

description: SPECIAL NOTICE Fort Campbell Operation and Maintenance, Army (OMA) Construction and Related Facility Support Requirements Contractor Repository � Fort Campbell, KY (Federal Acquisition Regulation (FAR) 12.201-1(d) (DEVIATION 2026-O0028)) PURPOSE The Mission and Installation Contracting Command (MICC), Fort Campbell, KY, is issuing this Special Notice to identify small business concerns interested in receiving future request for quotations for various construction and related facility-support requirements at Fort Campbell, KY. In accordance with Federal Acquisition Regulation (FAR) 12.201-1(d) (DEVIATION 2026-O0028), the Government intends to establish and maintain a repository of interested and qualified small businesses concerns. The repository will be used to efficiently distribute future requirement-specific requests for quotations to firms that respond to this notice and represent that they can perform the applicable work. The Government�s objectives are to: Reduce administrative costs and procurement lead time; Improve opportunities for small business concerns; Promote efficiency and economy in contracting; and Avoid unnecessary burdens for the Government and contractors. This Special Notice is not a solicitation, request for quotations or commitment by the Government to issue a purchase order (PO). The Government will not reimburse respondents for any costs associated with preparation or submission of a response to this notice. Anticipated Requirements The Government anticipates requirements primarily associated with NAICS Code 236220, Commercial and Institutional Building Construction, including repair, alteration, maintenance, minor construction, and related facility-support work. Although NAICS Code 236220 (Size Standard: $45.0 Million. Product Service Code (PSC): Z2JZ - Repair or alteration of miscellaneous buildings.) is identified as the primary anticipated NAICS code for this notice. Individual future requirements may require a different NAICS code, product service code (PSC), size standard, scope, licensing requirement, bonding threshold, or other requirement appropriate to the specific work. Anticipated work may include, but is not limited to: General construction, repair, and alteration of facilities; Carpentry, masonry, welding, roofing, painting, electrical, plumbing, and heating, ventilation, and air conditioning (HVAC) work; Civil, site, drainage, earthwork, and related utility work; Demolition and removal services; Hoist and crane inspection, maintenance, repair, and related services; Environmental, energy-conservation, logistical, and other facility-support requirements; and Other construction or service requirements supporting Fort Campbell facilities and infrastructure. Geographic Area Performance will occur at Fort Campbell, KY, (Zip Code: 42223) and may include associated facilities located within: Tennessee: Montgomery and Stewart County Kentucky: Christian and Trigg County Acquisition, Eligibility, and Registration Requirements The Government anticipates executing future requirements through individual purchase orders (POs) on an as-needed basis. Individual POs are anticipated to range from $2,000 to $9,000,000. Each individual PO or associated request for quotation will specify the applicable statement of work, performance location, completion date or period of performance, submission instructions, evaluation criteria, and other terms and conditions. To be considered for future opportunities, interested contractors must meet and maintain the following requirements, as applicable to each individual requirement: Small Business Participation: This initiative is focused on expanding opportunities for small business concerns. The Government encourages participation from all small business socioeconomic categories, including Small Business (SB), Small Disadvantaged Business (SDB), 8(a) Business Development Program participants, Historically Underutilized Business Zone (HUBZone) small businesses, Service-Disabled Veteran-Owned Small Businesses (SDVOSB), and Women-Owned Small Businesses (WOSB). SAM Registration: Contractors must maintain an active registration in the System for Award Management (SAM) and possess a valid Unique Entity Identifier (UEI) to be eligible for award. Installation Access: Contractors must be able to obtain and maintain the personnel credentials, vehicle access, insurance, and other installation-access requirements necessary to perform work at Fort Campbell. Requirement-specific access instructions will be provided for each individual PO, as applicable. Insurance and Bonding: Contractors must be able to provide current and valid proof of general liability insurance and meet applicable bonding requirements at the time of award. Any required bid guarantees, performance bonds, payment bonds, or other insurance and bonding documentation will be identified in the individual request for quotation or PO. Inclusion in the contractor repository does not constitute prequalification, guarantee receipt of a future request for quotation, or guarantee award of a PO. The Government may renew or repost the notice annually, as needed. Firms responding to this notice may be included in the Government�s repository of interested contractors. Inclusion in the repository: Does not constitute prequalification; Does not establish a contract, blanket purchase agreement, ordering agreement, or other contractual instrument; Does not guarantee that a firm will receive a future requirement notice, be invited to quote, or receive an award; and Does not relieve a firm from meeting the terms, conditions, and evaluation criteria established for each individual requirement. When a requirement is identified that falls within the scope of this notice, the Government intends to distribute a requirement-specific notice by email to repository firms identified as potentially capable of performing that work. Each requirement-specific notice may include: A scoping statement or description of the requirement; Applicable NAICS code, PSC, and size standard; Site-visit date, time, location, and access instructions, if applicable; Submission instructions and proposal due date; Required statement of work (SOW), technical approach, pricing, or other quote content; Evaluation criteria and basis for award; and Any applicable bonding, licensing, insurance, safety, security, or other performance requirements. Site visits may be conducted for individual requirements. Attendance is not mandatory; however, attendance is strongly encouraged. The Government will evaluate quotations and make any award in accordance with the procedures, terms, and evaluation criteria stated in the individual requirement-specific notice. title: Pre-Solicitation Notice for Indefinite Delivery Contract (IDC) for Regional Dredge Multiple Award Task Order Contract (MATOC) - USACE Huntington District - W91237-26-R-A024
description: 1. CONTRACT INFORMATION: The contract consists of a base period of one-year with four option periods, one-year each for maintenance dredging and/or clearing and snagging services for Ohio River Government Lock facilities and Ohio River open channel areas (within commercial navigation limits) located in the geographical boundaries of the following U.S. Army Corps of Engineers, Great Lakes and Ohio River Division Districts: Nashville (LRN), Louisville (LRL), Huntington (LRH), and Pittsburgh (LRP). There will be no site visit for this requirement. The award of a target of (3) Firm Fixed price Indefinite Delivery, Indefinite Quantity Multiple Award Task Order Contracts (IDIQ-MATOC) is anticipated. The contracts will be awarded to up to three (3) qualifying Offerors. The total capacity for the sum of all task orders issued under these contracts is a shared Not to Exceed (NTE) amount of $80,000,000.00. This announcement is open to all businesses regardless of size. The NAICS code for this procurement is 237990, which has a size standard of $37 million in average annual receipts. If a large business is awarded this contract, it must comply with RFO Clause 52.219-9 Alt II Small Business Subcontracting Plan, Alternate II. Solicitation documents will be available on or about October 02, 2026, and can be downloaded at https://www.sam.gov. 2. PROJECT INFORMATION: The primary objective of this contract is to provide maintenance dredging and/or clearing and snagging services for Ohio River Government lock facilities and Ohio River open channel areas (within commercial navigation limits) located anywhere within the geographical boundaries of the following Great Lakes and Ohio River Division Districts: Nashville (LRN), Louisville (LRL), Huntington (LRH), and Pittsburgh (LRP). This includes work on any navigable tributary of the Ohio River system.3. SELECTION CRITERIA: The selection criteria for this contract are listed below in descending order of importance. (a) Past Performance: Each offerors past performance will be reviewed to determine the recency of experience, relevancy of experience, and the quality of performance for an overall confidence assessment. (b) Small Business Participation Plan: Submissions must demonstrate the minimum requirements in sufficient detail for the level of proposed participation of small businesses in the performance of this acquisition. Offerors shall provide narratives for any element for which they cannot meet the minimum requirements. Failure to provide narratives will be interpreted as a lack of valid explanations to meet minimum requirements. Small Business Participation Plans containing details above and beyond the minimum requirements may be given greater consideration. (c) Price Reasonableness: Price reasonableness will be utilized in the evaluation of the firm-fixed price effort.4. SUBMISSION REQUIREMENTS: Proposers shall submit all documents electronically through PIEE Solicitation Module at www.piee.eb.mil. No paper copies, CD, DVD, thumb drives, email, or facsimile will be accepted. To be eligible for award, a firm must be registered in System for Award Management (SAM). Register via the SAM internet site at www. SAM.gov. Questions may be submitted to Amy L. Davis; amy.l.davis@usace.army.mil. Please note, as of April 2018, GSAs System for Award Management (SAM) system requires new registrations and renewals of existing registrations to submit an original signed notarized letter identifying the authorized Entity Administrator. The notarized letter is not to be submitted to the Huntington Contracting Office as it is not our requirement. Vendors are encouraged to check their entitys status in www.SAM.gov and plan accordingly. If the prospective contractor is not registered in the SAM database, the Contracting Officer will follow the procedures in FAR 4.1103. Contact the supporting Federal Service Desk at www.fsd.gov, or by telephone at 866-606-8220 (toll free) or 334-206-7828 (internationally) Monday through Friday from 8am to 8pm EDT, for free assistance. The SAM registration process may take several weeks to process once submitted. Please carefully consider this information when deciding to submit your proposal.

title: Hungary – Pipe fittings – DBR - Megfúró bilincsek, megcsapolók beszerzése
description: Dinamikus beszerzési rendszer (a továbbiakban: DBR) létrehozása megfúró bilincsek, megcsapolók beszerzésére. A beszerzendő termékek és azok jellemzői: Megcsapoló híd műanyag csövekre D63 – D315 mérettartományban, megfúró bilincsek azbesztcement, acél és öntvény csövekre DN50 – DN300 mérettartományban, a vonatkozó közbeszerzési dokumentumokban – különösen, de nem kizárólagosan az ajánlattételi szakaszokban megküldésre kerülő Műszaki leírásban és árazótáblában – foglalt. elvárt előírásoknak paramétereknek mindenben megfelelő termékek szállítása az ajánlattételi szakaszokban részletezettek szerint. A beszerezni tervezett termékek becsült mennyisége: 20 000 darab. Egy ajánlattételi szakasz útján egyszerre legfeljebb 105.000.000 Ft értékű terméket tervez beszerezni az ajánlatkérő. A mennyiség meghatározására kizárólag a Kbt. 107. § (2) bekezdésében előírtaknak való megfelelés érdekében került sor, az AK korábbi felhasználási tapasztalatai alapján, azonban e mennyiség lehívására az AK nem vállal kötelezettséget, az ajánlattételi szakaszok eredményeként ettől eltérő mennyiségű áru/termék beszerzésére is sor kerülhet. A jellemző időtartam egy ajánlattételi szakasz alapján negyedév, fél év vagy egy év. Egy évnél rövidebb vagy hosszabb időtartamra történő beszerzési is lehetséges az aktuális üzemi igények függvényében. A Dunántúli Regionális Vízmű Zrt., maga is mint jelen eljárás Ajánlatkérője a Kbt. 32. § (1)-(2) bekezdése alapján központi beszerző szervként került kijelölésre az alábbi ajánlatkérők által: ALFÖLDVÍZ Regionális Víziközmű-szolgáltató Zrt., ÉRV. Északmagyarországi Regionális Vízművek Zrt., DMRV Duna Menti Regionális Vízmű Zrt., Északdunántúli Vízmű Zrt., Tiszamenti Regionális Vízművek Zrt., Kiskunsági Víziközmű- Szolgáltató Korlátolt Felelősségű Társaság. A Dunántúli Regionális Vízmű Zrt. a DBR-t a fent felsorolt ajánlatkérő társaságok beszerzési igényének ellátására hozza létre. A DBR-t a fent felsorolt ajánlatkérő szervezeteken kívül az állami integrációban részt vevő víziközmű-társaságok vehetik igénybe. Az ajánlatkérő a közbeszerzési igényeket indokolt esetben - figyelemmel a szállítási helyekre, termékekre - társaságonként külön ajánlattételi felhívások útján is megvalósíthatja, amely keretében csak meghatározott termékek is beszerzésre kerülhetnek, azaz az AK egy ajánlattételi felhívás útján nem köteles valamennyi, a DBR-ben meghatározott terméket beszerezni. Az ajánlattételi szakaszokat a Dunántúli Regionális Vízmű Zrt. fogja központi beszerző szervként az egyes ajánlatkérők számára lefolytatni. Az ajánlattételi szakaszok eredményeként a szerződést az adott ajánlattételi szakaszban/adott ajánlattételi szakasz ajánlati részében megjelölt Ajánlatkérő fogja saját magára vonatkozóan megkötni. A DBR időtartama 48 hónap. Ajánlatkérő nem ír elő ajánlati biztosítékot. A részletes feltételeket a közbeszerzési dokumentumok tartalmazzák.

description: This notice serves to announce per FAR 5.1 and 5.2 that 772nd Contracting Squadron will award a sole source contract for AAOS authored Emergency Medical Responder, 8th Edition Premier Package, Emergency Care and Transportation for the Sick and Injured, 13th Edition Premier Package, and Advanced Emergency Care and Transportation for the Sick and Injured, 4th Edition Premier Package including online tools access including Navigate Premier Access, FISDAP Assessment EMT, and FISDAP Skills Tracker. description: THIS IS AN AWARD NOTICE FOR SOLICITATION W50S9526BA003 / CONTRACT W50S9526CA002 This is a commercial service construction project in accordance with E.O.14271The USPFO for South Carolina intends to issue an Invitation for Bid to award a single firm fixed- price contract for services, non-personal, to provide all plant, labor, transportation, materials, tools, equipment, appliances, and supervision necessary to repair maintenance hangar to meet standard by utilizing conventional design and construction methods at McEntire JNGB. The scope of this project will consist of for adequate and efficient indoor workspace to maintain assigned and transient aircraft and provide organizational, administrative, component repair, logistical, tool storage, meeting, classroom, and other spaces. Work includes construction upgrades to the existing 65,000+ SF facility. Facility currently consists of hangar space, maintenance space, administrative, training, and storage spaces. Existing windows will be replaced throughout the facility with new energy efficient windows. Existing roof will be removed and replaced. The existing bi-parting sliding main hangar doors are to be removed and replaced with new doors. The existing unidirectional sliding Phase Dock hangar door is to be refurbished and receive new exterior skin. The existing facility shall be upgraded with new plumbing, mechanical, electrical, and fire protection systems with an emphasis on energy efficiency and conservation. The work is located at McEntire Joint National Guard Base near Eastover in Richland County, South Carolina. The award is anticipated to consist of the following line items (CLINs): CLIN 0001: Base Bid, in addition to the base work described above, the solicitation will include the following optional line items: CLIN 0002: Bid Option 1A: Eastern hangar trench drain and sewer modification, CLIN 0003: Bid Option 1B: Western hangar trench drain modification, CLIN 0004: Bid Option 2: Remove and replace existing generator, and CLIN 0005: Bid Option 3: Maintain temporary facilities through Phase 2. The magnitude of the project is between $10,000,000.00 and $25,000,000.00. The project is anticipated to occur in two phases with a total contract duration of 550 days after notice to proceed (NTP). The first phase includes demolition and renovations to the main hangar, shops opening to the rear of the main hangar, and the second floor organizational and admin space. The second phase includes renovations to the Phase Dock Hangar, the Fabrication Shop, and the Tire Room. description: Dinamikus beszerzési rendszer (a továbbiakban: DBR) létrehozása különféle golyóscsapok beszerzésére. A beszerzendő termékek és azok jellemzői: Hagyományos golyóscsap, kombinált golyóscsap, megfúró golyóscsap, a vonatkozó közbeszerzési dokumentumokban – különösen, de nem kizárólagosan az ajánlattételi szakaszokban megküldésre kerülő Műszaki leírásban és árazótáblában – foglalt, elvárt előírásoknak paramétereknek mindenben megfelelő termékek szállítása az ajánlattételi szakaszokban részletezettek szerint. A beszerezni tervezett termékek becsült mennyisége: 25.000 darab. Egy ajánlattételi szakasz útján egyszerre legfeljebb nettó 272.000.000 Ft összegű terméket tervez beszerezni az ajánlatkérő. A mennyiség meghatározására kizárólag a Kbt. 107. § (2) bekezdésében előírtaknak való megfelelés érdekében került sor, az AK korábbi felhasználási tapasztalatai alapján, azonban e mennyiség lehívására az AK nem vállal kötelezettséget, az ajánlattételi szakaszok eredményeként ettől eltérő mennyiségű áru/termék beszerzésére is sor kerülhet. A jellemző időtartam egy ajánlattételi szakasz alapján negyedév, fél év vagy egy év. Egy évnél rövidebb vagy hosszabb időtartamra történő beszerzési is lehetséges az aktuális üzemi igények függvényében. A Dunántúli Regionális Vízmű Zrt., maga is mint jelen eljárás Ajánlatkérője a Kbt. 32. § (1)-(2) bekezdése alapján központi beszerző szervként került kijelölésre az alábbi ajánlatkérők által: ALFÖLDVÍZ Regionális Víziközmű-szolgáltató Zrt., ÉRV. Északmagyarországi Regionális Vízművek Zrt., DMRV Duna Menti Regionális Vízmű Zrt., Északdunántúli Vízmű Zrt., Tiszamenti Regionális Vízművek Zrt., Kiskunsági Víziközmű- Szolgáltató Korlátolt Felelősségű Társaság. A Dunántúli Regionális Vízmű Zrt. a DBR-t a fent felsorolt ajánlatkérő társaságok beszerzési igényének ellátására hozza létre. A DBR-t a fent felsorolt ajánlatkérő szervezeteken kívül az állami integrációban részt vevő víziközmű-társaságok vehetik igénybe. Az ajánlatkérő a közbeszerzési igényeket indokolt esetben - figyelemmel a szállítási helyekre, termékekre - társaságonként külön ajánlattételi felhívások útján is megvalósíthatja, amely keretében csak meghatározott termékek is beszerzésre kerülhetnek, azaz az AK egy ajánlattételi felhívás útján nem köteles valamennyi, a DBR-ben meghatározott terméket beszerezni. Az ajánlattételi szakaszokat a Dunántúli Regionális Vízmű Zrt. fogja központi beszerző szervként az egyes ajánlatkérők számára lefolytatni. Az ajánlattételi szakaszok eredményeként a szerződést az adott ajánlattételi szakaszban/adott ajánlattételi szakasz ajánlati részében megjelölt Ajánlatkérő fogja saját magára vonatkozóan megkötni. A DBR időtartama 24 hónap. Ajánlatkérő nem ír elő ajánlati biztosítékot. A részletes feltételeket a közbeszerzési dokumentumok tartalmazzák.

description: ARCHITECT-ENGINEER INDEFINITE DELIVERY/INDEFINITE QUANTITY MULTIPLE AWARD TASK ORDER CONTRACT FOR GENERAL DESIGN AND OTHER RELATED SERVICES WITHIN THE BOUNDARIES OR ASSIGNMENTS OF MISSISSIPPI VALLEY DIVISION, UNITED STATES ARMY CORPS OF ENGINEERS Solicitation (Synopsis) Number: W912P826RA012 Set-Aside Code: Unrestricted with a Partial Small Business Set-Aside Product Service Code: C219 - Architect and Engineering - General North American Industrial Classification System Code: 541330 - Engineering Services 1. CONTRACT INFORMATION: These services are being procured in accordance with 40 United States Code, Chapter 11, Selection of Architects and Engineers Statute, Revolutionary Federal Acquisition Regulation Overhaul (RFO) Part 36. Firms will be selected for negotiation based on demonstrated competence and qualifications for the required work stated in this synopsis. This is not the Request for Proposal. Interested firms shall respond by submitting one Standard Form (SF) 330 listing their qualifications. North American Industrial Classification System Code is 541330, which has a size standard of $25,500,000 in average annual receipts. This Indefinite Delivery/Indefinite Quantity (IDIQ) Multiple Award Task Order Contract (MATOC) announcement is Unrestricted with a Partial Small Business Set-Aside pool. The resulting task orders will be negotiated Firm Fixed-Price for General Design and other related services. Multiple contract awards are anticipated, with a performance of five years, with four negotiated rate escalations each year after the initial first year. The total MATOC shared pool capacity shall not exceed $90,000,000 or five-year duration, whichever comes first. The minimum guarantee throughout the five-year contract is $1,000. Responding firms must address each evaluation criteria in the appropriate sections of the SF 330 for the prime contractor as well as all subcontractors and consultants. If subcontracted, clearly indicate what part of the scope they will be performing. To be eligible for the contract award, the firm must be registered in the Department of Defense (DoD) System for Award Management (SAM). Register via the SAM Internet site at https://www.sam.gov. For contractors requiring Common Access Cards (CAC) or contractors requiring unescorted access to USACE controlled property for greater than six (6) months the Centralized Suitability Service Center (CSSC) requires a T1 Background Investigation to be completed. Should a task order require a T1 Background Investigation it will be specified. title: Poland – Portable computers – Dostawa laptopów na rzecz sądów powszechnych
description: 1. Przedmiotem postępowania jest ustanowienie Dynamicznego Systemu Zakupów (zwanego dalej DSZ) dla udzielania zamówień na dostawy laptopów (zwanych dalej sprzętem) na rzecz sądów powszechnych, Krajowej Szkoły Sądownictwa i Prokuratury i Centrum Zakupów dla Sądownictwa Instytucja Gospodarki Budżetowej, zwanych łącznie Jednostkami, będącymi nabywcami dostaw w ramach DSZ. Wykaz Jednostek stanowi Załącznik nr 9 do SWZ. Przedmiotem zamówienia w ramach DSZ jest dostawa laptopów wraz z zapewnieniem usług gwarancyjnych tego sprzętu. 2. Przedmiot zamówienia w ramach DSZ został podzielony sześć Kategorii: a) Kategoria 1: Laptop typ 1 - standardowy w szacowanej ilości 535 sztuk w całym okresie obowiązywania DSZ (Kategoria 1 dotyczy jednorazowych zamówień w maksymalnej ilości do 50 sztuk włącznie); b) Kategoria 2: Laptop typ 1 - standardowy w szacowanej Ilości 10 154 sztuk w całym okresie obowiązywania DSZ (Kategoria 2 dotyczy jednorazowych zamówień w ilości powyżej 50 sztuk); c) Kategoria 3: Laptop typ 2 - ponadstandardowy w szacowanej Ilości 173 sztuk w całym okresie obowiązywania DSZ (Kategoria 3 dotyczy jednorazowych zamówień w maksymalnej ilości do 50 sztuk włącznie); d) Kategoria 4: Laptop typ 2 - ponadstandardowy w szacowanej Ilości 3 285 sztuk w całym okresie obowiązywania DSZ (Kategoria 4 dotyczy jednorazowych zamówień w ilości powyżej 50 sztuk); e) Kategoria 5: Laptop typ 2, wersja 1 - ponadstandardowy w szacowanej ilości 682 sztuk w całym okresie obowiązywania DSZ (Kategoria 5 dotyczy jednorazowych zamówień w maksymalnej ilości do 50 sztuk włącznie); f) Kategoria 6: Laptop typ 2, wersja 1 - ponadstandardowy w szacowanej Ilości 1 025 sztuk w całym okresie obowiązywania DSZ (Kategoria 6 dotyczy jednorazowych zamówień w ilości powyżej 50 sztuk); 3. Zamawiający dopuszcza możliwości składania wniosków o dopuszczenie do udziału w DSZ na jedną, kilka lub wszystkie Kategorie. 4. Opis minimalnych parametrów sprzętów objętych DSZ w ramach danej Kategorii oraz minimalny wymagany okres gwarancji dla sprzętów, określony został w Załączniku nr 2 do SWZ – Opisie przedmiotu zamówienia. 5. Celem ustanowienia DSZ jest kwalifikacja podmiotowa Wykonawców, zdolnych do wykonania przedmiotowego zamówienia w okresie obowiązywania DSZ w oparciu o ustalone w Rozdziale VII SWZ warunki udziału w tym postępowaniu. 6. DSZ obowiązywać będzie przez okres 36 miesięcy od dnia jego ustanowienia tj. pierwszej kwalifikacji podmiotowej Wykonawców, którzy złożyli wnioski o dopuszczenie do udziału w DSZ w odpowiedzi na ogłoszenie o zamówieniu lub do wyczerpania maksymalnej szacowanej ilości sprzętu, w zależności od tego, które ze zdarzeń nastąpi wcześniej. 7. Procedury udzielenia zamówień realizacyjnych w ramach ustanowionego DSZ we wszystkich Kategoriach mogą prowadzić na swoją rzecz wszystkie Jednostki wskazane w Wykazie (sądy powszechne, Krajowa Szkoła Sądownictwa i Prokuratury i Centrum Zakupów dla Sądownictwa Instytucja Gospodarki Budżetowej). Ponadto Sądy Apelacyjne mogą prowadzić procedury udzielenia zamówień realizacyjnych w ramach ustanowionego DSZ we wszystkich Kategoriach na rzecz podległych sądów powszechnych, wskazując jako lokalizacje dostaw lokalizacje poszczególnych sądów lub własną lokalizację dostaw. 8. Przewidywane terminy wszczęcia procedur udzielenia zamówień realizacyjnych w okresie obowiązywania DSZ: Zamawiający przewiduje, że: a) zagregowane procedury udzielenia zamówień realizacyjnych o charakterze centralnym, będą prowadzone przez Zamawiającego raz na pół roku, w zależności od realnych potrzeb zgłaszanych przez Jednostki, w szczególności w Kategorii 2, 4 i 6; b) pozostałe procedury udzielenia zamówień realizacyjnych będą prowadzone samodzielnie przez Jednostki - sukcesywnie, w zależności od realnych potrzeb Jednostek, w szczególności w Kategorii 1, 3 i 5. 9. Realizacja dostaw sprzętu objętego DSZ w poszczególnych Kategoriach odbywać się będzie po przeprowadzeniu, za pośrednictwem Systemu, o którym mowa w Rozdziale XII pkt 3 SWZ, procedur udzielenia zamówień realizacyjnych w ramach DSZ, wszczynanych Zaproszeniem do składania ofert skierowanym do wszystkich zakwalifikowanych uczestników DSZ w danej Kategorii. 10. Wykaz Jednostek, na rzecz których prowadzone jest postępowanie oraz uprawnionych do prowadzenia procedur udzielenia zamówień realizacyjnych we wszystkich Kategoriach i udzielania zamówień realizacyjnych zawiera Załącznik nr 9 do SWZ. 11. Pierwszy termin składania wniosków o dopuszczenie do udziału w DSZ w poszczególnych kategoriach, wskazany w SWZ wyznaczono na dzień 13.09.2024r. do godziny 11:00. Po przekazaniu Zaproszenia do składania ofert dotyczących pierwszego zamówienia objętego DSZ, kolejnych terminów na składanie wniosków o dopuszczenie do udziału w DSZ nie wyznacza się. Wykonawca nieobjęty DSZ w danej kategorii może złożyć wniosek w dowolnym czasie obowiązywania DSZ. 12. Kryteria oceny ofert zostały określone w Rozdziale XIV SWZ, przy czym waga wskazanych kryteriów z ramach parametrów technicznych w poszczególnych Kategoriach zostanie sprecyzowana na etapie Zaproszeń do składania ofert w procedurach udzielania zamówień realizacyjnych objętych DSZ 13. Zamawiający informuje, iż na etapie poprzedzającym przygotowanie postępowania, przeprowadził drogą korespondencyjną wstępne konsultacje rynkowe z zainteresowanymi przedstawicielami Producentów, na podstawie art. 84 ustawy z dnia 11 września 2019 r. Prawo zamówień publicznych (tj.: Dz. U. z 2023 r., poz. 1605 z późn. zm.).

In Hinblick auf die dafür einschlägigen gesetzlichen Vorschriften zur Vergabe öffentlicher Aufträge, findet ein regelmäßiger Prozess wirkstoffbezogener, förmlicher Vergabeverfahren nach den Regularien des 4. Teils des GWB durch die DAK-Gesundheit statt. Für vom Bieter näher in der Anlage 2 zum Vertrag zu benennende Arzneimittel zu dem o. g. Wirkstoff Doravirin, ATC J05AG06, beabsichtigt die DAK-Gesundheit, bis zum Inkrafttreten neuer Arzneimittelrabattverträge mit möglichst allen interessierten pharmazeutischen Unternehmen Arzneimittelrabattverträge abzuschließen. Ein Rabattvertrag i.R.d. Zulassungsmodells zu dem o. g. Wirkstoff tritt erstmals am 01.12.2025 in Kraft und endet am 30.11.2027. Er endet unabhängig davon automatisch mit Inkrafttreten des Exklusivvertrages.

title: DOD USAMRDC FY23-FY27 BROAD AGENCY ANNOUNCEMENT for Extramural Medical Research Department of Defense Dept. of the Army -- USAMRAA
description: The USAMRDC�s mission is to provide solutions to medical problems of importance to the American Service Member at home and abroad, as well as to the general public at large. The scope of this effort and the priorities attached to specific projects are influenced by changes in military and civilian medical science and technology (S&T), operational requirements, military threat assessments, and national defense strategies. Extramural research and development programs play a vital role in the fulfillment of the objectives established by the USAMRDC. General information on the USAMRDC can be obtained at https://mrdc.health.mil/. This BAA is intended to solicit extramural research and development ideas using the authority provided by 10 USC 4001. The BAA is issued under the provisions of the Competition in Contracting Act of 1984 (Public Law 98-369), as implemented in FAR 6.102(d)(2) and 35.016 and in Department of Defense Grant and Agreement Regulations (DoDGARs) 22.315. In accordance with FAR 35.016, projects funded under this BAA must be for basic and applied research to support scientific study and experimentation directed toward advancing the state-of-the-art or increasing knowledge or understanding rather than focusing on development of a specific system or hardware solution. Research and development funded through this BAA are intended and expected to benefit and inform both military and civilian medical practice and knowledge. This BAA utilizes competitive procedures in accordance with 10 USC 2302(2)(B) for the selection for award of S&T proposals/applications. For the purposes of this BAA, S&T includes activities involving basic research, applied research, advanced technology development, and, under certain conditions, may include activities involving advanced component development and prototypes. The selection process is highly competitive, and the quantity of meaningful submissions (both pre-proposals/pre-applications and full proposals/applications) received typically exceeds the number of awards that available funding can support. This BAA provides a general description of USAMRDC�s research and development programs, including Research Areas of Interest, evaluation and selection criteria, pre-proposal/ pre-application and full proposal/application preparation instructions, and general administrative information. Specific submission information and additional administrative requirements can be found in the document titled, �General Submission Instructions,� which is available on Grants.gov along with this BAA. The FY23-FY27 USAMRDC BAA is continuously open for a 5-year period, from October 1, 2022 through September 30, 2027, at 11:59 p.m. Eastern Time. Submission of a pre-proposal/pre-application is required and must be submitted through the electronic Biomedical Research Application Portal (eBRAP) (https://eBRAP.org/). Pre-proposals/pre-applications may be submitted at any time throughout the 5-year period. If the USAMRDC is interested in receiving a full proposal/application, the Principal Investigator will be sent an invitation to submit via eBRAP. A full proposal/application must be submitted through Grants.gov (http://www.grants.gov/). Invited full proposals/applications can be submitted under this FY23-FY27 BAA through September 30, 2027.

title: Instruments Upgrade - Nitrogen & Hydrogen Generators
description: THIS IS A NOTICE OF INTENT TO SOLE SOURCE, NOT A REQUEST FOR A QUOTE (RFQ). A RFQ WILL NOT BE ISSUED AND QUOTES WILL NOT BE REQUESTED. Naval Surface Warfare Center Indian Head Division (NSWC, IHD), intends to award a firm fixed price contract on a noncompetitive basis to Peak Scientific, Inc. - 210 Littleton RD STE 110- Westford, Massachusetts 01886-3580 to provide the following service: Genius XE 35 laboratory nitrogen generator QTY 2 Peak Scientific Instruments Ltd BOTTLE-DRAIN QTY 2 This action is be undertaken in accordance with FAR 12.102 (a) Soliciting from a single source, on the basis that the vendor is the only known source capable of meeting the government�s requirements The North American Industry Classification System (NAICS) for this requirement is 334519. title: Finland – Health and social work services – Osallistumispyyntö: Väestövastuullisen ammatinharjoittajalääkäripalvelun hankinta
description: Hankinnan kohteena on yleislääkäri palveluiden hankinta ammatinharjoittajalääkärimallin mukaiseen työskentelyyn Länsi-Uudenmaan hyvinvointialueelle. Hankittavalla palvelulla tuotetaan yleislääkäripalvelut kokonaisvaltaisesti sovitulle vastuuväestölle. Hankittava palvelu sisältää vastaanottokäynnit, etäkontaktit, toimenpiteet, reseptityön, lausunnot, kuntoutussuunnitelmat sekä vastuuväestöä koskeviin muiden ammattilaisten konsultaatioihin vastaamisen. Sopimus on voimassa toistaiseksi ja sopimus astuu voimaan, kun molemmat Osapuolet ovat sen allekirjoittaneet. Tarkempi kuvaus hankinnan sisällöstä on tarjouspyynnön liitteellä 1. "Hankinnan kohteen kuvaus". Länsi-Uudenmaan hyvinvointialue ei sitoudu tiettyihin hankintamääriin sopimuskauden aikana.

Only white papers will be accepted as initial submissions; formal proposals will be accepted by invitation only. While white papers will be considered if received prior to 0500 PM Eastern Standard Time (EST) on 30 Sep 2027, the following submission dates are suggested to best align with projected funding: FY23 by 2 Mar 2023 FY24 by 15 September 2023 FY25 by 15 September 2024 FY26 by 15 September 2025 FY27 by 15 September 2026 Offerors should monitor the Contract Opportunities on the SAM website at https://SAM.gov in the event this announcement is amended. AFRL desires innovations to move from this current state to a significantly more on demand, self-forming, self-healing aerial layer network. Research in network monitoring and management, robust aerial networks, and proof of concept capabilities are sought to advance this objective. This BAA is a follow-on to BAA FA8750-19-S-7001 entitled �Timely, Secure & Mission Responsive Aerial Warfighting Network Capabilties�. title: FY27 City Pair Program Award
description: This procurement is for scheduled certificated U.S. airlines to provide passenger transportation services, Government-wide, for over 17,000 domestic/international airport or city pairs. The requirement-type contracts will be for one year beginning October 1, 2026, plus one 2-month option period and one 1-month option period. The contracts are for the movement of passengers and are used by almost all Federal Agencies and various other authorized users. Travel agent services will not be solicited under this solicitation. Prior to award, air carriers must be approved by the Department of Defense (DOD), as well as have the appropriate Federal Aviation Administration certification. Carriers who are otherwise eligible must also participate in the Civil Reserve Air Fleet (CRAF) program or receive a Letter of CRAF Technical Ineligibility from the United States Transportation Command (USTRANSCOM). For information regarding the CRAFprogram, call the DOD Commercial Airlift Division at (618) 229-4801. The FY27 City Pair Program has awarded items to 8 carriers: Alaska Airlines, American Airlines, Breeze Airways, Delta Air Lines, JetBlue Airways, Key Lime Air, Southwest Airlines and United Airlines.

title: AERIAL LAYER NETWORKING & TRANSMISSION TECHNOLOGIES
description: NAICS CODE: 541715 FEDERAL AGENCY NAME: Department of the Air Force, Air Force Materiel Command, AFRL - Rome Research Site, AFRL/Information Directorate, 26 Electronic Parkway, Rome, NY, 13441-4514 BAA ANNOUNCEMENT TYPE: Initial announcement BROAD AGENCY ANNOUNCEMENT BAA: Aerial Layer Networking & Transmission Technologies BAA NUMBER: FA8750-23-S-7002 PART I � OVERVIEW INFORMATION This announcement is for an Open, 2 Step BAA which is open and effective until 30 Sep 2027. Only white papers will be accepted as initial submissions; formal proposals will be accepted by invitation only. While white papers will be considered if received prior to 0500 PM Eastern Standard Time (EST) on 30 Sep 2027, the following submission dates are suggested to best align with projected funding: FY23 by 2 Mar 2023 FY24 by 15 September 2023 FY25 by 15 September 2024 FY26 by 15 September 2025 FY27 by 15 September 2026 Offerors should monitor the Contract Opportunities on the SAM website at https://SAM.gov in the event this announcement is amended. CONCISE SUMMARY OF TECHNOLOGY REQUIREMENT: Today�s aerial layer �network� architecture requires significant pre-planning and has limited interoperability. AFRL desires innovations to move from this current state to a significantly more on demand, self-forming, self-healing aerial layer network. Research in network monitoring and management, robust aerial networks, and proof of concept capabilities are sought to advance this objective. This BAA is a follow-on to BAA FA8750-19-S-7001 entitled �Timely, Secure & Mission Responsive Aerial Warfighting Network Capabilties�. BAA ESTIMATED FUNDING: Total funding for this BAA is approximately $99.5M. Individual awards will not normally exceed 36 months with dollar amounts normally ranging from $1M to $10M. There is also the potential to make awards up to $49.5M. ANTICIPATED INDIVIDUAL AWARDS: Multiple Awards are anticipated. However, the Air Force reserves the right to award zero, one, or more Procurement Contracts, Other Transactions, or assistance instruments, for all, some ,or none of the solicited effort based on the offeror�s ability to perform desired work and funding fluctuations. There is no limit on the number of OTs that may be awarded to an individual offeror. TYPE OF INSTRUMENTS THAT MAY BE AWARDED: FAR based Procurement contracts, DODGARS based grants and cooperative agreements or other transactions (OT) under 10 USC 4021, 10 USC 4022 and 10 USC 4023 (previously 10 USC 4003, 2371, 10 USC 4003, 2371b and 4004, 2373) depending upon the nature of the work proposed. In the event that an Other Transaction for Prototype agreement is awarded as a result of this competitive BAA, and the prototype project is successfully completed, there is the potential for a prototype project to transition to award of a follow-on production contract or transaction. The Other Transaction for Prototype agreement itself will also contain a similar notice of a potential follow-on production contract or agreement. AGENCY CONTACT INFORMATION: All white paper submissions and any questions of a technical nature shall be directed to the cognizant Technical Point of Contact (TPOC) as specified below (unless otherwise specified in the technical area): BAA PROGRAM MANAGER: Timothy Weaver AFRL/RITGA 525 Brooks Rd Rome, NY 13441-4505 Telephone: (315)330-2958 Email: timothy.weaver.16@us.af.mil <mailto:timothy.weaver.16@us.af.mil> Questions of a contractual/business nature shall be directed to the cognizant contracting officer, as specified below (email requests are preferred): Amber Buckley Telephone (315) 330-3605 Email: Amber.Buckley@us.af.mil <mailto:Amber.Buckley@us.af.mil> Emails must reference the solicitation BAA number and title of the acquisition. Pre-Proposal Communication between Prospective Offerors and Government Representatives: Dialogue between prospective offerors and Government representatives is encouraged. Technical and contracting questions can be resolved in writing or through open discussions. Discussions with any of the points of contact shall not constitute a commitment by the Government to subsequently fund or award any proposed effort. Only Contracting Officers are legally authorized to commit the Government. Offerors are cautioned that evaluation ratings may be lowered and/or proposal rejected if proposal preparation (Proposal format, content, etc.) and/or submittal instructions are not followed. title: FY27 City Pair Program Award
description: This procurement is for scheduled certificated U.S. airlines to provide passenger transportation services, Government-wide, for over 17,000 domestic/international airport or city pairs. The requirement-type contracts will be for one year beginning October 1, 2026, plus one 2-month option period and one 1-month option period. The contracts are for the movement of passengers and are used by almost all Federal Agencies and various other authorized users. Travel agent services will not be solicited under this solicitation. Prior to award, air carriers must be approved by the Department of Defense (DOD), as well as have the appropriate Federal Aviation Administration certification. Carriers who are otherwise eligible must also participate in the Civil Reserve Air Fleet (CRAF) program or receive a Letter of CRAF Technical Ineligibility from the United States Transportation Command (USTRANSCOM). For information regarding the CRAFprogram, call the DOD Commercial Airlift Division at (618) 229-4801. The FY27 City Pair Program has awarded items to 8 carriers: Alaska Airlines, American Airlines, Breeze Airways, Delta Air Lines, JetBlue Airways, Key Lime Air, Southwest Airlines and United Airlines.

title: AERIAL LAYER NETWORKING & TRANSMISSION TECHNOLOGIES
description: NAICS CODE: 541715 FEDERAL AGENCY NAME: Department of the Air Force, Air Force Materiel Command, AFRL - Rome Research Site, AFRL/Information Directorate, 26 Electronic Parkway, Rome, NY, 13441-4514 BAA ANNOUNCEMENT TYPE: Initial announcement BROAD AGENCY ANNOUNCEMENT BAA: Aerial Layer Networking & Transmission Technologies BAA NUMBER: FA8750-23-S-7002 PART I � OVERVIEW INFORMATION This announcement is for an Open, 2 Step BAA which is open and effective until 30 Sep 2027. Only white papers will be accepted as initial submissions; formal proposals will be accepted by invitation only. While white papers will be considered if received prior to 0500 PM Eastern Standard Time (EST) on 30 Sep 2027, the following submission dates are suggested to best align with projected funding: FY23 by 2 Mar 2023 FY24 by 15 September 2023 FY25 by 15 September 2024 FY26 by 15 September 2025 FY27 by 15 September 2026 Offerors should monitor the Contract Opportunities on the SAM website at https://SAM.gov in the event this announcement is amended. CONCISE SUMMARY OF TECHNOLOGY REQUIREMENT: Today�s aerial layer �network� architecture requires significant pre-planning and has limited interoperability. AFRL desires innovations to move from this current state to a significantly more on demand, self-forming, self-healing aerial layer network. Research in network monitoring and management, robust aerial networks, and proof of concept capabilities are sought to advance this objective. This BAA is a follow-on to BAA FA8750-19-S-7001 entitled �Timely, Secure & Mission Responsive Aerial Warfighting Network Capabilties�. BAA ESTIMATED FUNDING: Total funding for this BAA is approximately $99.5M. Individual awards will not normally exceed 36 months with dollar amounts normally ranging from $1M to $10M. There is also the potential to make awards up to $49.5M. ANTICIPATED INDIVIDUAL AWARDS: Multiple Awards are anticipated. However, the Air Force reserves the right to award zero, one, or more Procurement Contracts, Other Transactions, or assistance instruments, for all, some ,or none of the solicited effort based on the offeror�s ability to perform desired work and funding fluctuations. There is no limit on the number of OTs that may be awarded to an individual offeror. TYPE OF INSTRUMENTS THAT MAY BE AWARDED: FAR based Procurement contracts, DODGARS based grants and cooperative agreements or other transactions (OT) under 10 USC 4021, 10 USC 4022 and 10 USC 4023 (previously 10 USC 4003, 2371, 10 USC 4003, 2371b and 4004, 2373) depending upon the nature of the work proposed. In the event that an Other Transaction for Prototype agreement is awarded as a result of this competitive BAA, and the prototype project is successfully completed, there is the potential for a prototype project to transition to award of a follow-on production contract or transaction. The Other Transaction for Prototype agreement itself will also contain a similar notice of a potential follow-on production contract or agreement. AGENCY CONTACT INFORMATION: All white paper submissions and any questions of a technical nature shall be directed to the cognizant Technical Point of Contact (TPOC) as specified below (unless otherwise specified in the technical area): BAA PROGRAM MANAGER: Timothy Weaver AFRL/RITGA 525 Brooks Rd Rome, NY 13441-4505 Telephone: (315)330-2958 Email: timothy.weaver.16@us.af.mil <mailto:timothy.weaver.16@us.af.mil> Questions of a contractual/business nature shall be directed to the cognizant contracting officer, as specified below (email requests are preferred): Amber Buckley Telephone (315) 330-3605 Email: Amber.Buckley@us.af.mil <mailto:Amber.Buckley@us.af.mil> Emails must reference the solicitation BAA number and title of the acquisition. Pre-Proposal Communication between Prospective Offerors and Government Representatives: Dialogue between prospective offerors and Government representatives is encouraged. Technical and contracting questions can be resolved in writing or through open discussions. Discussions with any of the points of contact shall not constitute a commitment by the Government to subsequently fund or award any proposed effort. Only Contracting Officers are legally authorized to commit the Government. Offerors are cautioned that evaluation ratings may be lowered and/or proposal rejected if proposal preparation (Proposal format, content, etc.) and/or submittal instructions are not followed. title: FY27 City Pair Program Award
description: This procurement is for scheduled certificated U.S. airlines to provide passenger transportation services, Government-wide, for over 17,000 domestic/international airport or city pairs. The requirement-type contracts will be for one year beginning October 1, 2026, plus one 2-month option period and one 1-month option period. The contracts are for the movement of passengers and are used by almost all Federal Agencies and various other authorized users. Travel agent services will not be solicited under this solicitation. Prior to award, air carriers must be approved by the Department of Defense (DOD), as well as have the appropriate Federal Aviation Administration certification. Carriers who are otherwise eligible must also participate in the Civil Reserve Air Fleet (CRAF) program or receive a Letter of CRAF Technical Ineligibility from the United States Transportation Command (USTRANSCOM). For information regarding the CRAFprogram, call the DOD Commercial Airlift Division at (618) 229-4801. The FY27 City Pair Program has awarded items to 8 carriers: Alaska Airlines, American Airlines, Breeze Airways, Delta Air Lines, JetBlue Airways, Key Lime Air, Southwest Airlines and United Airlines.

title: Recompete of UC-12 Platform Training Program
description: This competitive Firm-Fixed Price IDIQ contract was awarded in accordance with FAR Part 12 - Acquisition of Commercial Items and FAR Part 15 - Contracting by Negotiation to support the Navy's Command Aircraft Crew Training (CACT) program for classroom and simulator training for the UC-12B/F/M/W aircraft. The UC-12 is a Navy variant of the King Air B200 (UC-12B/F/M) and B300/350 (UC-12W). The UC-12 program requirements consist of commercial academic and simulator training for several areas, such as pilot initial, pilot recurrent, international procedures initial, international procedures recurrent, and additional simulator periods as required.

description: This procurement is for scheduled certificated U.S. airlines to provide passenger transportation services, Government-wide, for over 17,000 domestic/international airport or city pairs. The requirement-type contracts will be for one year beginning October 1, 2026, plus one 2-month option period and one 1-month option period. title: Rocket Experimentation for Global Agile Logistics (REGAL)
description: The Department of the Air Force (DAF) is exploring point-to-point space transportation capability for DOD logistics. Based on the advertised commercial capability and business objectives for point-to-point space transportation, the Air Force Research Laboratory (AFRL) is currently assessing emerging commercial rocket capability under the DAF Rocket Cargo Vanguard program, and the potential to quickly transport DOD materiel to ports across the globe. To this end, the Rocket Experimentation for Global Agile Logistics (REGAL) program will explore the use of commercially-advertised rocket launch systems for rapid point-to-point (PTP) space transportation and agile global logistics. The goal is to field a capability that can deliver DoD cargo anywhere on the planet in less than one hour through service-type contracts similar to agreements DoD uses today with commercial airlines. Expected missions include emergency resupply to restore loss of mission capability, humanitarian relief, disaster relief, and ultimately routine and affordable transport of cargo to select DOD ports across the world. No funding will be invested in developing commercial rocket systems. Please refer to the Advanced Research Announcement (ARA) attachment for additional information. The ARA does not solicit proposals. Individual requirements known as �Call(s) for Proposals� will be issued against the ARA. Each Call for Proposals will contain the specific requirements and proposal submission dates. Unless otherwise stated in a specific Call, all other requirements are listed within the ARA. This initial announcement includes two (2) Calls for Proposals. Call 001 "Point-to-Point Capability and Operational Demonstrations" and Call 002 "Point-to-Point Rocket Demonstrations". Please refer to each respective attachment for additional information regarding specific requirements. Offerors should be alert for any ARA updates or future Call(s) for Proposals solicited as an amendment to this notice. This ARA shall remain open until 1 July 2027.

description: NAICS CODE: 541715 FEDERAL AGENCY NAME: Department of the Air Force, Air Force Materiel Command, AFRL - Rome Research Site, AFRL/Information Directorate, 26 Electronic Parkway, Rome, NY, 13441-4514 BAA ANNOUNCEMENT TYPE: Initial announcement BROAD AGENCY ANNOUNCEMENT BAA: Aerial Layer Networking & Transmission Technologies BAA NUMBER: FA8750-23-S-7002 PART I � OVERVIEW INFORMATION This announcement is for an Open, 2 Step BAA which is open and effective until 30 Sep 2027. Only white papers will be accepted as initial submissions; formal proposals will be accepted by invitation only. While white papers will be considered if received prior to 0500 PM Eastern Standard Time (EST) on 30 Sep 2027, the following submission dates are suggested to best align with projected funding: FY23 by 2 Mar 2023 FY24 by 15 September 2023 FY25 by 15 September 2024 FY26 by 15 September 2025 FY27 by 15 September 2026 Offerors should monitor the Contract Opportunities on the SAM website at https://SAM.gov in the event this announcement is amended. CONCISE SUMMARY OF TECHNOLOGY REQUIREMENT: Today�s aerial layer �network� architecture requires significant pre-planning and has limited interoperability. AFRL desires innovations to move from this current state to a significantly more on demand, self-forming, self-healing aerial layer network. Research in network monitoring and management, robust aerial networks, and proof of concept capabilities are sought to advance this objective. This BAA is a follow-on to BAA FA8750-19-S-7001 entitled �Timely, Secure & Mission Responsive Aerial Warfighting Network Capabilties�. BAA ESTIMATED FUNDING: Total funding for this BAA is approximately $99.5M. Individual awards will not normally exceed 36 months with dollar amounts normally ranging from $1M to $10M. There is also the potential to make awards up to $49.5M. ANTICIPATED INDIVIDUAL AWARDS: Multiple Awards are anticipated. However, the Air Force reserves the right to award zero, one, or more Procurement Contracts, Other Transactions, or assistance instruments, for all, some ,or none of the solicited effort based on the offeror�s ability to perform desired work and funding fluctuations. There is no limit on the number of OTs that may be awarded to an individual offeror. TYPE OF INSTRUMENTS THAT MAY BE AWARDED: FAR based Procurement contracts, DODGARS based grants and cooperative agreements or other transactions (OT) under 10 USC 4021, 10 USC 4022 and 10 USC 4023 (previously 10 USC 4003, 2371, 10 USC 4003, 2371b and 4004, 2373) depending upon the nature of the work proposed. title: DLA Energy FY 2027 Annual Procurement Forecast of Petroleum Acquisitions
description: In accordance with FAR part 5, for acquisitions covered by the World Trade Organization Government Procurement Agreement or a Free Trade Agreement, the period of time between publication of the synopsis notice and receipt of offers must be no less than 40 days. However, if the acquisition falls within a general category identified in an annual forecast, the availability of which is published, the contracting officer may reduce this time period to as few as 10 days. The Defense Logistics Agency (DLA) Energy is publicizing its annual forecast with the general type and quantity that DLA anticipates procuring during fiscal year 2027. The forecast represents estimated quantities foreign and domestic. FY2027 Bulk & PCS 69.344 million barrels Intro-Plane 3.939 million barrels Bunkers 2.012 million barrels Non-contract 2.182 million barrels TOTAL 77.476 million barrels The above quantities are estimates only and potential offerors seeking to do business with DLA Energy should refer to the individual solicitations for precise quantities.

title: Germany – Pharmaceutical products – Abschluss nicht exkl. Arzneimittel-Rabattvereinb. nach § 130a Abs. 8 SGB V im Wege eines Open-House-Modells zum Wirkstoff Epoetin alfa und Epoetin zeta (ATC-Code nach WHO: B03XA01)
description: Gegenstand dieser Veröffentlichung ist der Abschluss nicht exklusiver Rabattvereinbarungen nach § 130a Abs. 8 SGB V über Arzneimittel mit dem Wirkstoff Epoetin alfa und Epoetin zeta (ATC-Code nach WHO: B03XA01). Der Vertragsabschluss erfolgt im Rahmen eines sog. Open-House-Modells, d. h. ein Vertragsabschluss steht innerhalb des Teilnahmezeitraums allen interessierten pharmazeutischen Unternehmen offen, sofern diese die Teilnahmevoraussetzungen erfüllen und akzeptieren. Dies hat zur Folge, dass individuelle Vertragsverhandlungen nicht geführt werden und eine (Liefer-)Exklusivität nicht gegeben ist. Es wird darauf hingewiesen, dass die Abnahmemenge unbekannt ist, da diese von der Nachfrage und der Entwicklung der Versichertenzahl, von dem Verordnungsverhalten der Ärzte sowie dem Abgabe- und Bevorratungsverhalten der öffentlichen Apotheken abhängig ist. Mindestabnahmemengen werden demensprechend nicht garantiert. Interessierte pharmazeutische Unternehmer können die Teilnahmeunterlagen über den Projektraum des Deutschen Vergabeportals (DTVP) herunterladen. Dazu ist zunächst ein Antrag auf Zugang zum Projektraum erforderlich. Nach erfolgter Freischaltung durch die Auftraggeberin kann anschließend auf die Teilnahmeunterlagen zugegriffen werden. Über den Inhalt der Teilnahmeunterlagen - insbesondere über den Inhalt der Rabattvereinbarung und den dort genannten Rabatten - ist absolutes Stillschweigen zu bewahren. Eine vollständige oder teilweise Weitergabe oder Zugänglichmachung von Inhalten der Teilnahmeunterlagen an bzw. für Dritte bedarf der vorherigen schriftlichen Zustimmung der Auftraggeberin. Sofern von einer Teilnahme abgesehen wird, sind alle Unterlagen unverzüglich datenschutzgerecht zu vernichten. Die einzureichenden Unterlagen ergeben sich aus den im Projektraum hinterlegten Dokumenten "Anschreiben" und "Erläuterungen der Vertragsbedingungen". Die Kommunikation, einschließlich der Übermittlung der Teilnahmeunterlagen, erfolgt elektronisch über das Vergabeportal DTVP; Einzelheiten hierzu sind den zuvor genannten Dokumenten zu entnehmen. Etwaige anderslautende Angaben in der Auftragsbekanntmachung sind technischen Gründen geschuldet und beanspruchen keine Verbindlichkeit. Teilnahmeanträge können erstmals bis zum 30. April 2026 eingereicht werden. Alle weiteren Einreichungsfristen entnehmen Sie bitte der im Projektraum hinterlegten Anlage "Einreichungsfristen". Fällt der Tag der Einreichungsfrist auf einen Sonnabend, Sonntag oder bundesweit gesetzlichen Feiertag, so tritt an die Stelle eines solchen Tages der nächste Werktag. Bei verspätetem Zugang werden die eingereichten Teilnahmeanträge zur nächsten Einreichungsfrist berücksichtigt. Die Rabattvereinbarung endet, unabhängig vom Datum des Vertragsschlusses, spätestens zum 30. September 2027. Die Auftraggeberin behält sich vor, das Open-House-Verfahren vorzeitig zu beenden, insbesondere im Falle des Abschlusses exklusiver Rabattvereinbarungen; in diesem Fall enden die bereits geschlossenen Rabattvereinbarungen nach Maßgabe der vertraglichen Bestimmungen. Den Erfahrungen der Auftraggeberin nach treten exklusive Rabattvereinbarungen in der Regel 8 bis 12 Monate nach der Veröffentlichung der entsprechenden Auftragsbekanntmachung im Supplement zum Amtsblatt der Europäischen Union in Kraft.

title: Germany – Engineering services – Max-Planck-Institut für Gravitationsphysik, Hannover Umbau und Erweiterung Gebäude 3405 - „Fachplanung Technische Ausrüstung (Medizin- oder labortechnische Anlagen)“
description: Laborräume für die Abteilung und Forschungsgruppen: -Reinräume und Laserlabore mit optischen Tischen und Vakuumtanks für ALPS/VMB, LISA Testbedingungen und Beyond LISA Experimente. Die Tische haben ISO 5 Überbauten, im hinteren Bereich der Labore wird ein Versorgungsgang (Grauraum) angeschlossen. -Receiving, Cleaning, Testing und ein multipurpose lab sind ISO 7 oder wenigstens ISO 8 und werden genutzt, um neues Equipment oder ähnliches zu testen und für den Reinraumeinsatz zu präparieren. -Laserhalle mit 2 Vakuumtanks und Lasertischen als spezielle Experimentierfläche über 2 Etagen; getrennt durch Lager und mit Durchgang vom hinteren Teil. -fs-comb labor: Das Licht von dem „Uhrenlaser“ müsste in die anderen Labore via Faser verteilt werden. -Elektroniklabor, Chemielabor und EMV Operator.Angabe, falls erforderlich Interimsunterbringung: Die interimistische Unterbringung Guido Müllers ist hinsichtlich der Büroflächen im Gebäude 3409 der LUH (am gleichen Standort) vorgesehen, wofür eine Pinselsanierung erforderlich ist. Für den Laborbereich ist eine kleine Fläche im Untergeschoss des Gebäudes 3406 vorgesehen, zudem die Mitnutzung der Laborflächen im Bereich von Prof. Danzmann in der bestehenden Hälfte der Halle 3405. Der Raumbedarfsplan für den Umbau von Gebäude 3405 (Halle) umfasst rd.1.240 m² NUF 1-6 mit überwiegend hochinstallierten Flächen wie Labore, Reinraum und Experimentierhalle sowie einiger Büros. Besonderer Hinweis betr. Bieterfragen aufgrund besonderer äußerer Ereignisse (z.B. Sars-COV-2 oder Ukraine Krieg): Bitte berücksichtigen Sie bei Ihrer Angebotserstellung etwaige mögliche bzw. erkennbare Beeinträchtigungen, z.B. in Bezug auf die Verfügbarkeit von Materialien und Produkten, Arbeitskräften, eine evtl. verzögerte Beibringung von geforderten Nachweisen, Auswirkungen auf etwaige Nachunternehmer etc. Fragen, die in diesem Zusammenhang auftreten, bitten wir rechtzeitig vor Angebotsfrist über das Nachrichtensystem der eVergabe zu stellen.

description: 693JJ626R000001_00001: Amendment Description ___________________________________________________ The Federal Railroad Administration, Office of Research, Development, and Technology amends the FY26-27 Broad Agency Announcement (BAA) Appendix C � Research Topics document to remove the following four research topics that are �no longer available:� FRA-TR-005 � Innovative Methods for Measuring or Monitoring Longitudinal Rail Stress FRA-TR-006 � Research and Development on Track Lateral Strength FRA-TR-007 � Determining Pre Break Rail Neutral Temperature, Longitudinal Rail Restraint, and Best Rail Adjustment Practices FRA-TR-009 � Wheel/Rail Contact Evaluation 693JJ626R000001: Original Description________________________________________________________________________ The Federal Railroad Administration�s (FRA) FY 2026 Broad Agency Announcement (BAA) solicits a variety of applied research projects that will support Department of Transportation and FRA strategic objectives. The research needs are in the three FRA research areas: Track, Rolling Stock and Equipment, and Train Control and Communications. The BAA consists of several research topics for potential contractors to submit concept papers for FRA�s review. We recommend full and open competition for the FY 2026 BAA. Concept papers are approved if they meet the objectives of FRA research topics in the BAA. Contractors with approved concept papers will have the opportunity to submit a proposal for possible contract award. This effort extends for a period of 15 months, therefore the response date is anytime within the 15 month period. No concept papers will be reviewed after the ultimate deadline of 9/30/2027. However, this announcement is subject to periodic Amendments updating the status of available research topics. Once a research topic becomes unavailable, the research topic will be removed from the announcement allowing the available research topics to gain more visibility. The FRA is committed to excellence and welcomes top innovators, creators, professors, rail enthusiasts, and rail subject matter experts to take on this BAA opportunity.

title: U.S. Army Contracting Command � Watervliet Arsenal (ACC-WVA) Organic Industrial Base (OIB) Modernization Commercial Solutions Opening (CSO)
description: The Commercial Solutions Opening (CSO) authority is per Section 1823 of the National Defense Authorization Act (NDAA) for Fiscal Year 2026, which amended Section 3458 of Title 10, as codified by Public Law 119-60. DFARS Subpart 212.70 implements 10 U.S.C. 3458 for the acquisition of innovative commercial products or commercial services through the use of a general solicitation known as a Commercial Solutions Opening (CSO). This CSO is a competitive solicitation posted on a Government Point of Entry (GPE) www.sam.gov continuously open until 30 September 2027. This CSO will be utilized specifically for Watervliet Arsenal, and Benet Laboratories. ACC-WVA reserves the right to extend this CSO beyond the open until date by amendment. Under this CSO the DoW may seek solution briefs, presentations/pitches and/or proposals from traditional and non-traditional business entities. This CSO is intended to seek proposals for innovative commercial products, commercial technologies and services or adaptations/modifications of existing commercial product technologies and services to enable the seamless integration of manufacturing resources from across the enterprise to meet U.S. Army needs. This includes, but are not limited to, the linking of legacy analogue manufacturing systems with modern digital systems, the expansion of modeling and simulation to speed up decision making and the ability to deliver the right materiel solution to the soldier at the right time and in the right place. This CSO may result in the award of various types of contracts, which may include but are not limited to commercially-available technologies immediately available, commercially-available technologies fueled by commercial or strategic investment, but also concept demonstrations, pilots, and agile development activities that can incrementally improve commercial technologies, existing government-owned capabilities, or concepts for broad defense applications. ACC-WVA intends to award FAR-based contracts under Part 12 Commercial Item Procedures based on specific Area of Interest (AoI) and industrial base responses to the AoI. The CSO solicitation process may include a multi-phased solicitation and evaluation approach that is dependent upon specific AoIs. The AoIs are focused topic(s)/categories that will be published under this CSO. The following phases will be used: Phase 1 � Submission of Written Solution Brief, Phase 2 � Presentation/Pitch (if applicable), and Phase 3 � Request for Commercial Solution Proposal (CSP). A CSO is considered a competitive process, intended to ensure that competitive procedures are used to the maximum extent practicable. All solution briefs, presentations/pitches and/or proposals submitted in response to any AoI will be in response to and governed by this CSO. Use of a CSO in accordance with DFARS Subpart 212.70 is considered to be a competitive procedure for the purposes of 10 U.S.C. 221 and FAR 6.102. Finally, Contracting Officers shall treat items, technologies, and services acquired using a CSO as commercial items. Contracts or purchase orders resulting under this authority shall be fixed-price, including fixed-price incentive fee contracts. Additional information inclusive of instructions and definitions can be found on the attachment "CSO-Watervliet Arsenal FY26 Final.pdf" Current AOIs and current closing dates: A001 Advanced Cannon Technology closes on 30 September 2026 A002 UT System closes on 30 September 2026 A003 Electrical Infrastructure closes on 10 June 2026 A004 Chrome Facility Conversion closes on 30 November 2026 A005 Electronic Access Control System closes on 31 August 2026 A006 Automated Manufacturing Line of Minor Components closes on 20 November 2026

title: NASA SBIR/STTR FY 2026-2027 Broad Agency Announcement (BAA)
description: The NASA SBIR/STTR Program is moving to a Broad Agency Announcement (BAA) (See more in FAR 35.016 https://www.acquisition.gov/far/35.016) to procure research and development activities from small businesses. This Broad Agency Announcement (BAA) sets the requirements for you, the offeror, to submit a proposal to NASA for Small Business Innovation Research (SBIR) (including SBIR Ignite) and Small Business Technology Transfer (STTR) Program Phase I and Phase II projects. NASA will solicit proposals for specific funding opportunities by releasing appendices to this BAA throughout the effective period of this BAA. This document contains the objectives, funding information, proposal preparation instructions, and eligibility criteria. Each released appendix will contain instructions to submit a proposal package and the solicited research and technology subtopics for the specific funding opportunity. Requirements specific to each opportunity will be included in the appendices. In any instance where specific requirements in appendices conflict with requirements in the BAA, the specific requirements in the appendices take precedence for that opportunity. As of the release of this BAA, NASA does not have an exact number of planned appendices, but the program anticipates releasing 2 to 3 appendices each fiscal year. More information about the release schedule can be found on our website: https://www.nasa.gov/sbir_sttr/

title: Abschluss nicht exkl. Arzneimittel-Rabattvereinb. nach § 130a Abs. 8 SGB V im Wege eines Open-House-Modells zum Wirkstoff Teduglutid (ATC-Code nach WHO: A16AX08)
description: Gegenstand dieser Veröffentlichung ist der Abschluss nicht exklusiver Rabattvereinbarungen nach § 130a Abs. 8 SGB V über Arzneimittel mit dem Wirkstoff Teduglutid (ATC-Code nach WHO: A16AX08). Der Vertragsabschluss erfolgt im Rahmen eines sog. Open-House-Modells, d. h. ein Vertragsabschluss steht innerhalb des Teilnahmezeitraums allen interessierten pharmazeutischen Unternehmen offen, sofern diese die Teilnahmevoraussetzungen erfüllen und akzeptieren. Dies hat zur Folge, dass individuelle Vertragsverhandlungen nicht geführt werden und eine (Liefer-)Exklusivität nicht gegeben ist. Es wird darauf hingewiesen, dass die Abnahmemenge unbekannt ist, da diese von der Nachfrage und der Entwicklung der Versichertenzahl, von dem Verordnungsverhalten der Ärzte sowie dem Abgabe- und Bevorratungsverhalten der öffentlichen Apotheken abhängig ist. Mindestabnahmemengen werden demensprechend nicht garantiert. Interessierte pharmazeutische Unternehmer können die Teilnahmeunterlagen über den Projektraum des Deutschen Vergabeportals (DTVP) herunterladen. Dazu ist zunächst ein Antrag auf Zugang zum Projektraum erforderlich. Nach erfolgter Freischaltung durch die Auftraggeberin kann anschließend auf die Teilnahmeunterlagen zugegriffen werden. Über den Inhalt der Teilnahmeunterlagen - insbesondere über den Inhalt der Rabattvereinbarung und den dort genannten Rabatten - ist absolutes Stillschweigen zu bewahren. Eine vollständige oder teilweise Weitergabe oder Zugänglichmachung von Inhalten der Teilnahmeunterlagen an bzw. für Dritte bedarf der vorherigen schriftlichen Zustimmung der Auftraggeberin. Sofern von einer Teilnahme abgesehen wird, sind alle Unterlagen unverzüglich datenschutzgerecht zu vernichten. Die einzureichenden Unterlagen ergeben sich aus den im Projektraum hinterlegten Dokumenten "Anschreiben" und "Erläuterungen der Vertragsbedingungen". Die Kommunikation, einschließlich der Übermittlung der Teilnahmeunterlagen, erfolgt elektronisch über das Vergabeportal DTVP; Einzelheiten hierzu sind den zuvor genannten Dokumenten zu entnehmen. Etwaige anderslautende Angaben in der Auftragsbekanntmachung sind technischen Gründen geschuldet und beanspruchen keine Verbindlichkeit. Teilnahmeanträge können erstmals bis zum 3. September 2026 eingereicht werden. Alle weiteren Einreichungsfristen entnehmen Sie bitte der im Projektraum hinterlegten Anlage "Einreichungsfristen". title: DOD USAMRDC FY23-FY27 BROAD AGENCY ANNOUNCEMENT for Extramural Medical Research Department of Defense Dept. of the Army -- USAMRAA
description: The USAMRDC�s mission is to provide solutions to medical problems of importance to the American Service Member at home and abroad, as well as to the general public at large. The scope of this effort and the priorities attached to specific projects are influenced by changes in military and civilian medical science and technology (S&T), operational requirements, military threat assessments, and national defense strategies. Extramural research and development programs play a vital role in the fulfillment of the objectives established by the USAMRDC. General information on the USAMRDC can be obtained at https://mrdc.health.mil/. This BAA is intended to solicit extramural research and development ideas using the authority provided by 10 USC 4001. The BAA is issued under the provisions of the Competition in Contracting Act of 1984 (Public Law 98-369), as implemented in FAR 6.102(d)(2) and 35.016 and in Department of Defense Grant and Agreement Regulations (DoDGARs) 22.315. In accordance with FAR 35.016, projects funded under this BAA must be for basic and applied research to support scientific study and experimentation directed toward advancing the state-of-the-art or increasing knowledge or understanding rather than focusing on development of a specific system or hardware solution. Research and development funded through this BAA are intended and expected to benefit and inform both military and civilian medical practice and knowledge. This BAA utilizes competitive procedures in accordance with 10 USC 2302(2)(B) for the selection for award of S&T proposals/applications. For the purposes of this BAA, S&T includes activities involving basic research, applied research, advanced technology development, and, under certain conditions, may include activities involving advanced component development and prototypes. The selection process is highly competitive, and the quantity of meaningful submissions (both pre-proposals/pre-applications and full proposals/applications) received typically exceeds the number of awards that available funding can support. This BAA provides a general description of USAMRDC�s research and development programs, including Research Areas of Interest, evaluation and selection criteria, pre-proposal/ pre-application and full proposal/application preparation instructions, and general administrative information. Specific submission information and additional administrative requirements can be found in the document titled, �General Submission Instructions,� which is available on Grants.gov along with this BAA. The FY23-FY27 USAMRDC BAA is continuously open for a 5-year period, from October 1, 2022 through September 30, 2027, at 11:59 p.m. Eastern Time. Submission of a pre-proposal/pre-application is required and must be submitted through the electronic Biomedical Research Application Portal (eBRAP) (https://eBRAP.org/). Pre-proposals/pre-applications may be submitted at any time throughout the 5-year period. If the USAMRDC is interested in receiving a full proposal/application, the Principal Investigator will be sent an invitation to submit via eBRAP. A full proposal/application must be submitted through Grants.gov (http://www.grants.gov/). Invited full proposals/applications can be submitted under this FY23-FY27 BAA through September 30, 2027.
